en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a steamship navigating a narrow lock cut between steep rock faces. People stand along the quayside as the vessel moves through the canal-like lock system. Forested hills and further waterways can be seen in the background. Printed text in the lower left corner reads "Trollhättan, Slussparti," and the ship's stern shows additional text.
